propositions: A new NDJSON snapshot writer appends timestamped metric records (coverage, complexity, clone count) to a durable store for trend tracking across CI runs.
A snapshot reader filters and yields records within a specified date range, returning unavailable until snapshots exist.
The snapshot store must be committed under .rebar/ (not reports/) and un-ignored in .gitignore to ensure the series persists and syncs across the repository.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines are skipped without error, allowing the reader to return only valid records.
Unit tests verify round-trip write/read within date ranges, range exclusion, and corruption resilience.
The .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson path is tracked in git and verified to not match .gitignore rules.
